title: Enrique Delgado-Garcia Death: Cause Revealed - Telemundo New England
text:
Massachusetts State Trooper Dies Following Training Injury; Reforms Underway A Massachusetts State Police trooper, Enrique Delgado-García , died last September from complications stemming from head injuries sustained during boxing training, prompting an independent investigation and subsequent reforms to academy training protocols. The family’s legal counsel anticipates the official cause of death will be listed as “complications of intracranial hemorrhages due to injuries due to forceful impact on the head during physical training exercises.”
The tragic death of Delgado-García, who previously served as a victim and witness advocate in the Worcester County District Attorney’s office, has spurred a comprehensive review of the Massachusetts State Police Academy’s training regimen. The incident occurred at the New Braintree Academy, and the ensuing investigation has remained largely private for nearly a year, leaving the Delgado-García family awaiting closure.
Investigation Reveals Focus on Training Safety According to a statement released by the Massachusetts State Police on Wednesday, the agency initiated an internal assessment immediately following Delgado-García’s death. This assessment encompassed a wide range of factors, including training methodologies, participant attrition rates, injury prevention strategies, physical fitness standards, and the overall organizational culture within the academy.
“The Massachusetts State Police remembers and honors agent Enrique Delgado García as one of our fallen,” the statement read.
Reforms Announced in May The State Police announced a series of reforms in May, signaling a commitment to addressing potential safety concerns. These reforms included a commitment to hiring an external agency to conduct an additional, independent evaluation of the academy. The scope of this external review will focus on ensuring compliance with national standards and identifying areas for improvement.
The family’s attorney, Mike Wilcox, stated that a death certificate detailing the cause of death is expected to be filed with the municipal secretary of Worcester shortly. This formal documentation will provide a crucial piece of information for the family as they navigate their grief and seek answers.
The investigation’s limited public disclosure has understandably frustrated the Delgado-García family, who have been seeking clarity for almost a year. While details remain scarce, the State Police’s proactive response – including the internal assessment and commitment to an external review – suggests a dedication to preventing similar tragedies in the future. The agency’s actions reflect a growing awareness of the importance of prioritizing officer safety and well-being during rigorous training exercises.
